meta.title: The Lost Teddy
meta.textType: story, review lesson: a poster solves the problem

paragraphs: Pat is sad. His teddy is not in his bedroom. "Where is my teddy?" asks Pat. May looks under the bed. She looks behind the door. May makes a poster. The poster says, "WHERE IS PAT'S TEDDY?" "IT IS SMALL AND BROWN." "IT HAS GOT A RED HAT." "PLEASE COME TO THE WHITE HOUSE NEXT TO THE SCHOOL." May puts the poster in front of the shop.

Tom and Pip are in the street. They read the poster. "Who has got a small brown teddy?" asks Tom. Pip runs behind the shop. "Woof!" says Pip. In a box, there is a doll and a train. There is a small brown teddy too. It has got a red hat! Pip finds the teddy. "Is this Pat's teddy?" asks Tom. Tom reads the poster again. "Yes, it is!"
Tom and Pip go to May's white house. Tom has the teddy. "Pat! Here is your teddy!" "Hooray!" says Pat. "Thank you, Tom! Thank you, Pip!" Pat is happy again. Pip is a good dog.
text.summary: Pat loses his small brown teddy. May makes a poster, and Tom and Pip find the teddy behind the shop.
